episodes.synopsis: Akira Oono was a game dev who wanted to build his own world, free from corporate oversight. But he had no idea that he'd get dragged into his own creation as Hakuto Kunai, the Demon Lord of the Great Empire! His adventure picks up where it left off!
episodes.title: ReTry

episodes.synopsis: Akira and Kunai reflect on how far the village of Rabby has come, and the prosperity lying ahead of it.
episodes.title: ReStart

episodes.synopsis: Kunai heads to the town of Rookie to farm for magical items in the Prison Labyrinth there. He's accompanied by Mikan and Yukikaze, and sparks are sure to fly.
episodes.title: ReCycle

episodes.synopsis: News of Kunai's exploits reaches other nations around the world. How will they respond?
episodes.title: ReCruit

episodes.synopsis: Eagle reminisces on her life after being separated from Luna as the situation with her comes to a head. Meanwhile, Kunai gets a surprise visitor with an equally surprising request.
episodes.title: ReMind

episodes.synopsis: Things come to a head as all chaos breaks out around Eagle. Can she be saved?
episodes.title: ReUnion

episodes.synopsis: After the chaos dies down, Kunai returns to Organ, and they continue their journey into the Beast Kingdom.
episodes.title: ReMain

episodes.synopsis: Tensions flare up in Xenovia and their neighboring state of Parma as Kunai and gang continue their exploration of Beastkin territory.
episodes.title: ReCovery

episodes.synopsis: Kunai and Organ discuss their plans for their attack of Belphegor's castle, while Akane and Mink run off to make their own inroads.
episodes.title: ReQuest

episodes.synopsis: Kunai and Organ begin their attack on Belphegor's castle, with Monkeymagic and his troops providing assistance.
episodes.title: ReScue

episodes.synopsis: The squad of raiders ends up meeting the lord of the castle and the primary target, Archfield Belphegor, and the outcome is less than desirable.
episodes.title: ReSurrect

episodes.synopsis: Organ is in trouble, and it us up to Kunai to save the day.
episodes.title: ReVenge
